method: Bounded web-search samples and first-party provider pages; not Google Ads Keyword Planner, Search Console or a keyword-volume provider. Result inclusion/order is not a ranking measurement.

samples.query: website development Ottawa small business website redesign
samples.observation: Provider pages use website design/development, small-business and redesign language. This supports terminology, not measured demand.

samples.query: custom software development Ottawa small business
samples.observation: Local provider positions itself as custom software development in Ottawa. No Ternloom affiliation inferred.
Business workflow, data/application integration and internal-tool language overlaps. Broad automation searches also surfaced jobs; service/buyer modifiers matter.

limits: Search results are not a complete location-controlled Google SERP export.
No search volumes, difficulty scores, traffic forecasts, conversion rates or formal SERP-overlap percentages are available.
Keyword examples are research seeds, not claims that Ternloom already ranks for them.
Competitor claims, prices, guarantees and technology specializations are not copied into Ternloom content.
